extraction_scope: worker-6 non-overclaim mechanism adjudication from primary source; no direct biochemical mechanism assay was performed in this paper.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Remdesivir antiviral activity in Vero E6 SARS-CoV/SARS-CoV-2 CPE assay
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper measures antiviral replication inhibition by remdesivir but does not directly assay RNA-dependent RNA polymerase inhibition in this study.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Known RdRp mechanism is background from cited literature; this paper contributes cell-based EC50 activity evidence.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Alisporivir antiviral activity in Vero E6 SARS-CoV/SARS-CoV-2 CPE assay
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports alisporivir EC50 values and describes it as a known inhibitor of RNA-virus replication/CoV progeny production, without directly assaying cyclophilin-mediated mechanism here.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote to direct mechanism evidence; sequence/modification identity remains database conflict.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PEG-IFN-alpha pretreatment response in Vero E6 SARS-CoV/SARS-CoV-2 assay
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports that PEG-IFN-alpha completely inhibited SARS-CoV-2 replication at the lowest tested dose while SARS-CoV was less sensitive; this is phenotypic antiviral response evidence, not a direct molecular mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism should remain host-response context rather than direct peptide/membrane/nucleic-acid mechanism.
